description: Create a new database utilities module within the ak-common package that provides shared database functionality for the entire codebase. This module should include essential database operations and utilities that can be reused across different services and components.
functional_requirements: Implement core database connection and query utilities in a dedicated module
Design the module to be imported and used by other packages requiring database access
Include proper error handling and logging for database operations
Ensure the module follows the existing codebase patterns and conventions
Add the new module to the package's exports so it's accessible to other components
Update build configurations and dependencies to support the new database module
